name: @bsf/engine
description: The bpmn-svelte-flow (BSF) browser BPMN engine: executes standard BPMN 2.0 semantics with JavaScript (text/javascript) scripts, mocks, conditions and embedded tests over a bpmn-moddle tree. Zero runtime dependencies; runs in the browser and in bun/node, and ships the bsf-agent JSON-RPC CLI for LLM-agent-driven runs with durable on-disk state.

scripts.test: bun test/engine.test.mjs && bun test/agent-cli.test.mjs && bun test/conformance.test.mjs
